title: Emerald Dog in Toxic Dream
description: A large green dog with red splotches and glowing orange eyes sits in the foreground, mouth open, exhaling colorful ribbons and bubbles. Black smoke rises from industrial factories and oil derricks on its body and in the background. A blue reflection of the dog appears in a mirror behind it, while shelves of green specimens in jars line the right wall.
prompt: A large vibrant green dog with red splotches and glowing orange eyes sits in a dark blue surreal room, mouth open as colorful red, green and gold ribbons and bubbles flow from its mouth. Black smoke billows from miniature oil derricks and factories built into its back. Behind it a mirror reflects a blue version of the dog. Shelves on the right hold glass jars containing small green dog-like specimens. A pink and red sky is visible through a broken ceiling, in a dystopian industrial nightmare style.
